ulasan.Ulasan: Growing up I'd always wanted to visit this store. The way it looked and the window design was so appealing to me. My first visit was my last. When I came into the store, the clerk asked me to put my bag up. I looked around to see if anyone else had to do the same, and there was a woman walking the store with a bag slightly larger than mine that was not asked to do this. If you are going to practice this with some customers, you should practice this with all customers. This happened a while back, but I am now ready to share this experience. It's alienating, discriminatory, and will leave out the last word that encapsulates what happened.

ulasan.Ulasan: I love Arena's, can't quite afford everything here but love it!  They have some of the most beautiful and most exquisite vintage pieces in the entire city. And the floral arrangements they do are GORG.  The store is lovely and carries some fun local made items as well as beautiful vintage pieces. They have two levels and lock the door, so you will need to ring the doorbell to be let in.  Yes, the prices are high. But again, some of the pieces are hard to find.  I didn't experience any issues with customer service. They weren't the friendliest, but also not the rudest.  Parking is easy enough on the street.
